manual_checklist.title: SENASA import application submitted AND approved before travel
manual_checklist.detail: Travelers must submit an import application to SENASA before their trip, and the application must be approved by SENASA by the time of entry into Argentina. Do not tick this off on submission alone — wait for SENASA's approval, then tick it. Apply here: https://www.argentina.gob.ar/servicio/animales-vivos-importación-exportación

manual_checklist.title: Internal + external parasite treatment within 15 days
manual_checklist.detail: A licensed vet administers internal + external antiparasitic treatment within 15 days before travel, recorded on the export certificate.

manual_checklist.title: Under-3-month exemption: age + dam-vaccination attestation
manual_checklist.detail: Because this pet is under 3 months old, rabies vaccination is NOT required — but in its place SENASA requires a veterinary attestation of the animal's age and the dam's rabies-vaccination status. Obtain it from your vet and tick this off; the trip is not ready without it. (This item only appears for under-90-day pets.)
